name: apple
description: Control native macOS apps — Messages, Mail, Notes, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Maps — via AppleScript through the apple-mcp server. 8 tools, no API keys needed.

interface.shortDescription: Control macOS Messages, Mail, Notes, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Maps via AppleScript.
interface.longDescription: The Apple skill wraps jxnl/apple-mcp (forked from supermemoryai/apple-mcp), a Bun-based MCP server that uses AppleScript to drive Apple's native macOS applications. Exposes 8 tools: contacts (search by name), notes (search, list, create), messages (send, read, schedule, unread), mail (unread, search, send with attachments/cc/bcc, mailboxes, accounts), reminders (list, search, open, create, listById), calendar (search, open, list, create events with location/notes/allday), webSearch (DuckDuckGo), and maps (search, save, drop pins, directions, guides). No API keys or environment variables required — inherits the user's iCloud session. Requires bun on PATH + macOS accessibility permissions for the terminal app running the MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use the Apple skill to interact with native macOS apps — Messages, Mail, Notes, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Maps.
Before any send operation (messages/mail/calendar), confirm the content and recipient with the user.
Start with read operations (unread messages, upcoming events, recent notes) before making changes.
For messages, always resolve a contact name to a phone number using the contacts tool before trying to send.
